# Report information

This is a quality control report for immunopeptidomics experiments provided by:

Immunopeptidomics Platform (IPP)

Dr. David Gomez-Zepeda, Platform Head

email: david.gomez-zepeda@dkfz.de

## Data set information

**Sample Set:** `r params$SampleSet`

**Wetlab: ** `r params$WetLabNames`

**Data Analysis: ** `r params$DataAnalysisNames`

**Date:**  `r Sys.Date()` 

**Code author:** DGZ

**Code version:** `r packageVersion("HowMaHiCo")`

```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
#General parameters for knitr
require("knitr")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
if (!is.null(params$ProjectDir) && nzchar(params$ProjectDir))
  knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(params$ProjectDir, mustWork = FALSE))
```

```{r initialize, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(HowMaHiCo)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(viridis)
library(plotly)
library(openxlsx)
library(DT)

# handy settings

mhcclass_ranges <- list(MHC1 = c(8L, 13L), MHC2 = c(12L, 25L))
shortpep_range <- if (params$MHCclass %in% names(mhcclass_ranges)) {
  mhcclass_ranges[[params$MHCclass]]
} else {
  c(params$ShortPeptideLengthMin, params$ShortPeptideLengthMax)
}

mhcclass_palettes <- list(MHC1 = c("#fde725", "#440154"), MHC2 = c("#21918c", "#440154"))
shortpep_palette <- mhcclass_palettes[[if (params$MHCclass %in% names(mhcclass_palettes))
                                         params$MHCclass else "MHC1"]]
shortpep_colors <- setNames(shortpep_palette,
  c(paste0(shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs"), "others"))

if(params$Subset == ""){
  subset <- params$Subset
  FolderResults <- params$FolderResults
  FolderFigures <- params$FolderFigures
}else{
  subset <- paste0(params$Subset, "_")
  dir.create(file.path(params$FolderResults, params$Subset))
  dir.create(file.path(params$FolderFigures, params$Subset))
  FolderResults <- file.path(params$FolderResults, params$Subset)
  FolderFigures <- file.path(params$FolderFigures, params$Subset)
}

file_rda <- file.path( file.path(params$FolderData,paste0(subset, "pep_all.rda")))

# pre-checks to avoid overwriting files
check_output_exists(params$FolderResults, overwrite =  params$ResultsOverwrite)
check_file_exists(file_rda, overwrite =  params$ResultsOverwrite)
```

## Glosary

* Peptides (e.g. in barplots): this includes possible peptidoforms (i.e. different PTMs); although the peptides are often detected only in one peptidoform.
* Sequences (e.g. in Venn plots): this refers to the stripped peptide sequence regardless of the possible PTMs.
* Selected peptides or sequences: those with the expected length for the peptides being analyzed, 8-13 amino acids (AAs) for HLA1 and 12-20 AAs for HLA2

## Annexes

* Results are attached in folder 3_results
  * pep_all.csv = main results in long-format, contains all peptides identified
  * counts_pep_all_condition.csv = summary in wide format with the number of samples from each Condition where each peptide was detected
  * seq_by_condition.xlsx = individual lists of sequences for each Condition in each tab (regardless of overlap with other Conditions)
  * seq_overlap_condition.xlsx = list of sequences associated to the Condition(s) where they were identified
* Plots in folder 4_figures
  * some plots are exported into folder 4_figures, but they can also be copied or saved from this report

# Input

```{r input-annot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if(params$Instrument == "faims_orbi"){
  message("**IMPORTANT:** faims_orbi is not fully suported yet. For now, the Compensation Voltage (CV) is renamed as invko (1/k0) in the tables and used as mobility dimension in the plots")
}

annot <- read_annot(file.path(params$FolderDocumentation, params$AnnotationFile))

# check all files in annot exist in FolderData
expected_files <- if (grepl("fragpipe_dda", params$Software)) {
  file.path(params$FolderData, annot$Sample_fp, "psm.tsv")
} else if (params$Software == "diann") {
  file.path(params$FolderData, annot$Sample_fp, "report.tsv")
} else if (params$Software == "peaks_xpro") {
  file.path(params$FolderData, annot$Sample_peaks)
} else {
  character(0)
}
missing_files <- expected_files[!file.exists(expected_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  message("Missing files:")
  print(missing_files)
  stop("Files listed in annotation table were not found. Check FolderData and annotation paths.")
}

```




```{r print-annot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
print_annot(annot)
```


```{r load-pep-all, echo=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
#Loading files and calculating extra columns.



if(grepl("fragpipe_dda", params$Software)){
  message("loading fragpipe data")
  if(grepl("combined", params$Software)){
    annot_mode = "combined_file"
  }else{
    if(grepl("individual", params$Software)){
      annot_mode = "individual_files"
    }else{
      stop("please specify fragpipe_dda_individual or fragpipe_dda_combined")
    }
  }

pep_all <- read_fragpipe_batch(folder = params$FolderData, annotation = annot, testmode = params$TestMode)  %>%
  parse_fragpipe(., shortpep_range = shortpep_range) %>%
  annotate_fragpipe(annot, mode = annot_mode)
warning("for Fragpipe, the psm file is currently beeing used. This means that FDR has not been applied at the peptide level, only at PSM level")
}
if(params$Software == "diann"){
  message("loading diann data")
pep_all <- read_diann_batch(folder = params$FolderData, annotation = annot, testmode = params$TestMode)  %>%
  parse_diann(., shortpep_range = shortpep_range) %>%
  annotate_diann(annot)
warning("for DIA-NN, some columns are currently missing, including Mass and ppm (ppm = 0 as dummy)")

}
if(params$Software == "peaks_xpro"){
  message("loading PEAKS data")
  pep_all <- read_peaks_batch(folder = params$FolderData,
                              annotation = annot,
                              instrument = params$Instrument) %>%
    parse_peaks(., shortpep_range = shortpep_range) %>%
    annotate_peaks(annot)
}





save(pep_all, file = file_rda)
pep_short <- pep_all %>% 
    filter(Length >= shortpep_range[1], Length <= shortpep_range[2]) 

#extract simplified info
samples <- levels(pep_all$Sample)
conditions <- levels(pep_all$Condition)
n_conditions <- length(conditions)
bioreplicates <- levels(pep_all$BioReplicate)
comp_condition <- combn(conditions, 2) %>%  as.data.frame %>%  as.list
```


## Total IDs with decoys, DeNovo and contaminants

This evaluation includes all peptides identified, without filtering out peptides that were not assigned to any protein or peptides that could come from contaminant proteins (Accession labeled Cont_). These values are shown below. Some true peptides can be originated from proteins typically assigned as contaminant in proteomics experiments (e.g., actins, keratins, albumins, etc.).

```{r check-ids-global, echo=FALSE}
check_ids_global(pep_all) %>% 
  kable() %>% 
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)
```

# Identification counts

```{r counts-all, echo=FALSE}

counts_levels <- c("Peptides", "Sequences", "Proteins")

# Counts all peptides
## Sample 
counts_all <- pep_all %>%  
  group_by(Condition, BioReplicate, Sample) %>%
  summarise(n_Peptides = n_distinct(Peptide), 
            n_Sequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
            n_Proteins = n_distinct(Accession),
            .groups = "drop") 

## Condition average
counts_all_mean <-
  counts_all %>% 
  group_by(Condition) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),
                   list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
## Condition total
counts_all_total <- pep_all %>%  
  group_by(Condition) %>% 
  summarise(n_Peptides = n_distinct(Peptide), 
            n_Sequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
            n_Proteins = n_distinct(Accession),
            .groups = "drop") 

## BioReplicate per TechReplicate
counts_all_overlap <-
  pep_all %>% 
  filter(Area != 0) %>%
  count(Condition,  Accession, Peptide, Sequence, name = "n_Samples") %>% 
  mutate(n_Samples = factor(paste0(n_Samples, " Rep."))) %>% 
  group_by(Condition, n_Samples) %>% 
  summarise(n_Peptides = n_distinct(Peptide), 
            n_Sequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
            n_Proteins = n_distinct(Accession),
            .groups = "drop") %>%  
  full_join(rename_with(counts_all_total, ~gsub("n_", "total_", .x)), by = "Condition") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Condition, n_Samples), names_to = "Type_Level", values_to = "n") %>% 
  separate(Type_Level, sep = "_", into = c("Type", "Level")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Condition, n_Samples, Level), values_from = "n", names_from = "Type") %>% 
  arrange(Condition, Level, desc(n_Samples)) %>% 
  group_by(Condition, Level) %>% 
  mutate(perc = paste0("", round(100*(n/total), 1), "%"),
         cum = cumsum(n)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Condition, n_Samples), names_from = Level, values_from = all_of(c("n", "perc", "cum",  "total")))

## Limits for plots
count_lim <- data.frame(Level = c("Peptides", "Sequences", "Proteins"),
                        Limit_mean = c( ceiling((max(counts_all$n_Peptides)*1.2/100))*100,
                                   ceiling((max(counts_all$n_Sequences)*1.2/100))*100,
                                   ceiling((max(counts_all$n_Proteins)*1.3/100))*100),
                        Limit_total = c( ceiling((max(counts_all_total$n_Peptides)*1.2/100))*100,
                                   ceiling((max(counts_all_total$n_Sequences)*1.2/100))*100,
                                   ceiling((max(counts_all_total$n_Proteins)*1.2/100))*100))

### adaptation for running with all way of plotting for the overlaps

npep_ylim <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Peptides", "Limit_mean"]
nseq_ylim <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Sequences", "Limit_mean"]
nprot_ylim <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Proteins", "Limit_mean"]
npep_ylim_total <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Peptides", "Limit_total"]
nseq_ylim_total <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Sequences", "Limit_total"]
nprot_ylim_total <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Proteins", "Limit_total"]


# By LengthRange
## Sample 
counts_size <- 
  bind_rows(counts_all %>% 
              mutate(Length_range =  "All peptides"),
            pep_all %>% 
              group_by(Condition, BioReplicate, Sample, Length_range) %>%
              summarise(n_Peptides = n_distinct(Peptide), 
                        n_Sequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
                        n_Proteins = n_distinct(Accession),
                        .groups = "drop") %>% 
              arrange(Sample))  %>% 
  #arrange factors in a logical way
  mutate(Length_range = factor(Length_range, 
                               levels = c("All peptides", "others", paste0(shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs"))))

## Condition average
counts_size_mean <-
  counts_size %>% 
  group_by(Condition, Length_range) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),
                   list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                        sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
## Condition total
counts_size_total <-
  bind_rows(counts_all_total %>%
              mutate(Length_range =  "All peptides"),
            pep_all %>%
              group_by(Condition, Length_range) %>%
              summarise(n_Peptides = n_distinct(Peptide),
                        n_Sequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
                        n_Proteins = n_distinct(Accession),
                        .groups = "drop")) %>%
  #arrange factors in a logical way
  mutate(Length_range = factor(Length_range,
                               levels = c("All peptides", "others", paste0(shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs"))))

# Per-sample y-axis limits
counts_all_sample <- counts_size %>% dplyr::filter(Length_range == "All peptides")
count_lim$Limit_sample <- c(
  ceiling(max(counts_all_sample$n_Peptides)  * 1.2 / 100) * 100,
  ceiling(max(counts_all_sample$n_Sequences) * 1.2 / 100) * 100,
  ceiling(max(counts_all_sample$n_Proteins)  * 1.2 / 100) * 100
)
```

## Peptides identified per charge +1 to +4 {.tabset}

### charge proportion condition

```{r plot-charge-proportion, results='asis', echo=FALSE, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=8, warning=TRUE}
count_all_condition_charge <- 
  bind_rows(
    pep_all %>% 
      get_charge_group() %>% 
      group_by(Condition, Charge_group) %>% 
      count_ids() %>% 
        arrange(Condition, Charge_group),
    pep_all %>% 
      get_charge_group() %>% 
      group_by(Condition) %>% 
      count_ids() %>% 
      mutate(Charge_group = "Total")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(Charge_group = factor(Charge_group, rev(unique(Charge_group))) )
  
prop_all_condition_charge <- 
  count_all_condition_charge %>%
  get_proportion_charge()
bp_prop_all_condition_charge <- 
  prop_all_condition_charge %>% 
  plot_charge_proportions(Condition) +
  rotate_x_text(70) +
  ggtitle("Charge proportion all peptides")
# check if % > 100
tmp_prop_total <- 
  prop_all_condition_charge %>% 
  filter(Charge_group != "Total") %>% 
  group_by(Condition, Level) %>% 
  summarise(Proportion_Total = sum(Proportion), .groups = "drop")  
if(any(tmp_prop_total$Proportion_Total > 1)){
  warning("The total percentage is > 100% in some cases. This may be because some peptides can be reported with multiple charge states (e.g. in Fragpipe)")
}
rm(tmp_prop_total)

bp_prop_all_condition_charge
```

## Unique identifications across BioReplicates

```{r upset-tables, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
upset_table_pep <-
  pep_all %>% 
  mutate(Condition = as.character(Condition)) %>% 
  distinct(Condition, Peptide, .keep_all= FALSE) %>% 
  nest(Condition = Condition) %>% 
  group_by(Condition)  %>% 
  summarize(n_Peptide = n_distinct(Peptide), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(n_Condition = nrow(Condition)) %>% 
  mutate(Conditions= paste(Condition, collapse = ", ")) %>% 
  select(Conditions, n_Condition, n_Peptide) %>% 
  rbind(pep_all %>% 
          group_by(BioReplicate) %>% 
          summarize(Conditions = paste("Total", unique(BioReplicate)),
                    n_Peptide = n_distinct(Peptide), .groups = "drop",
                    n_Condition = 1) %>% 
          select(-BioReplicate)) %>% 
  rbind(pep_all %>% 
          summarize(Conditions = "Total",
                    n_Peptide = n_distinct(Peptide), .groups = "drop",
                    n_Condition = 1) ) 

upset_table_prot <-
  pep_all %>% 
  mutate(Condition = as.character(Condition)) %>% 
  distinct(Condition, Accession, .keep_all= FALSE) %>% 
  nest(Condition = Condition) %>% 
  group_by(Condition)  %>% 
  summarize(n_ProteinGroup = n_distinct(Accession), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(n_Condition = nrow(Condition)) %>% 
  mutate(Conditions = paste(Condition, collapse = ", ")) %>% 
  select(Conditions, n_Condition, n_ProteinGroup) %>% 
  rbind(pep_all %>% 
          group_by(BioReplicate) %>% 
          summarize(Conditions = paste("Total", unique(BioReplicate)),
                    n_ProteinGroup = n_distinct(Accession), .groups = "drop",
                    n_Condition = 1) %>% 
          select(-BioReplicate)) %>% 
  rbind(pep_all %>% 
          summarize(Conditions = "Total",
                    n_ProteinGroup = n_distinct(Accession), .groups = "drop",
                    n_Condition = 1)) 

upset_table_unique <-
  full_join(upset_table_pep[upset_table_pep$n_Condition == 1, ] %>% 
               select(-n_Condition), 
            upset_table_prot[upset_table_prot$n_Condition == 1, ]  %>% 
               select(-n_Condition), 
             by = "Conditions") %>% 
  rename_with(.fn =function(x) gsub("n_", "Unique_", x)) %>% 
  rename(Condition = Conditions)

upset_table_unique %>%  kable %>%   kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)
```


# Upset plots - overlap across Conditions {.tabset}

Below are shown the UpSet plots representing the overlap between the conditions evaluated. 

## All peptides {.tabset}

```{r plot-upset-all, echo=FALSE,  fig.height=3.5, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
var_levels <-  c("Peptide", "Sequence", "Accession")
up_pep_all_list <- plot_upset_batch(pep_all, vars = var_levels, Compare = "Condition")
for (i in 1:length(var_levels)) {
  cat("\n### ", var_levels[i],"\n")
  up_pep_all_list[i]  %>%  print()
  cat('\n\n')
```

# Condition pairwise overlap  {.tabset}


```{r overlap-pairwise-data, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8}
# calculations needed for Condition, Bioreplicate, and sample-wise overlap and uniqueness
npep_all_overlap <- pep_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_Peptides = dplyr::n_distinct(Peptide), .groups = "drop")

#complete condition comparison with same condition in each side
comp_condition_replicated <- c(combn(conditions, 2, simplify =  FALSE) , 
                               as.list(as.data.frame(t(data.frame(x = conditions, y = conditions)))))
#rename
names(comp_condition_replicated) <-  sapply(comp_condition_replicated, function(x) paste0(x, collapse  = "_vs_"))



pep_overlap <-
  data.frame(n_Overlap = sapply(comp_condition_replicated, 
                                function(x) count_intersect(pep_all, variable = "Peptide",
                                                            cond1 = x[1], cond2 = x[2])),
             n_Total = sapply(comp_condition_replicated, 
                                function(x) count_merged(pep_all, variable = "Peptide",
                                                            cond1 = x[1], cond2 = x[2]))) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Comparison") %>%
  separate(Comparison, into = c("Cond1", "Cond2"), sep = "_vs_") %>% 
  mutate(prop_Overlap_Total = round(n_Overlap/n_Total, 3)) %>% 
  # Add total IDs per condition and the proportion of overlap
  full_join(npep_all_overlap %>%  select(Condition, total_Peptides) %>% 
              unique %>% 
              rename(n_Peptides_Cond1 = total_Peptides),
            by = c("Cond1" = "Condition")) %>% 
  full_join(npep_all_overlap %>%  select(Condition, total_Peptides) %>% 
              unique %>% 
              rename(n_Peptides_Cond2 = total_Peptides),
            by = c("Cond2" = "Condition")) %>% 
  mutate(prop_Overlap_Cond1 = round(n_Overlap / n_Peptides_Cond1, 3),
         prop_Overlap_Cond2 = round(n_Overlap / n_Peptides_Cond2, 3))  %>% 
  mutate(Cond1 = factor(Cond1, levels = conditions), #reorder levels
         Cond2 = factor(Cond2, levels = conditions))
```


## Pairwise overlap matrix (counts)

```{r plot-overlap-matrix-counts, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8}
hm_overlap_matrix_count <-
  rbind(pep_overlap, 
      # Get mirror numbers to complete the matrix 
      pep_overlap %>% mutate(Cond1_temp = Cond1) %>% 
        mutate(Cond1 = Cond2, Cond2 = Cond1_temp) %>%  
        select(-Cond1_temp)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = Cond1, x = Cond2, fill = n_Overlap)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_Overlap), size = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis(alpha = 0.9, option = "D", begin =  0.1) +
  theme_rawr() +
  rotate_x_text(35)+
  ggtitle("Overlap of peptides identified across conditions")

hm_overlap_matrix_count
```

## Pairwise overlap matrix (proportion from total)

```{r plot-overlap-matrix-prop, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8}
hm_overlap_matrix_prop <-
  rbind(pep_overlap, 
      # Get mirror numbers to complete the matrix 
      pep_overlap %>% mutate(Cond1_temp = Cond1) %>% 
        mutate(Cond1 = Cond2, Cond2 = Cond1_temp) %>%  
        select(-Cond1_temp)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = Cond1, x = Cond2, fill = prop_Overlap_Total)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = prop_Overlap_Total), size = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis(alpha = 0.9, option = "D", begin =  0.1) +
  theme_rawr() +
  rotate_x_text(35)+
  ggtitle("Overlap of peptides identified across conditions (proportion from pairwise total)")

hm_overlap_matrix_prop
```

## Pairwise overlap table (counts and proportion)

- n_Total = distinct peptides when combining both conditions
- prop_Overlap_total = n_Overlap/n_Total
- prop_Overlap_Cond1 and prop_Overlap_Cond2 are different because they are calculated based on the total for only that condition

```{r table-overlap-pairwise, echo=FALSE}
pep_overlap %>%  kable() %>% kable_paper("hover", full_width = F) %>%

                                          alpha = 0.8,  begin = 0.2,
                                          direction = -1, scale_from = c(0,1))) %>% 
  column_spec(7,  background = spec_color(pep_overlap$prop_Overlap_Cond2,
                                          alpha = 0.8,  begin = 0.2,
                                          direction = -1, scale_from = c(0,1)))
```

# Correlation log2(Area) {.tabset}

Pearson correlation using pairwise complete-observations

```{r corr-log2area-data, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Get Log2Area matrices; NAs are kept as NA; mean is calculated if needed
## all peptides
pep_all_log2area_tr  <- get_mat_log2area(pep_all, PeptideID, Sample)
pep_all_log2area_br  <- get_mat_log2area(pep_all, PeptideID, BioReplicate)
prot_all_log2area_tr <- get_mat_log2area(pep_all, ProteinFirst, Sample)
prot_all_log2area_br <- get_mat_log2area(pep_all, ProteinFirst, BioReplicate)
## short peptides
pep_short_log2area_tr  <- get_mat_log2area(pep_short, PeptideID, Sample)
pep_short_log2area_br  <- get_mat_log2area(pep_short, PeptideID, BioReplicate)
prot_short_log2area_tr <- get_mat_log2area(pep_short, ProteinFirst, Sample)
prot_short_log2area_br <- get_mat_log2area(pep_short, ProteinFirst, BioReplicate)
```


## All peptides

```{r plot-corr-all, echo=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# Matrix of log2(Area)
corr_log2area_all <-  cor(pep_all_log2area_tr, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

#setup limits
corrarea_lim <- c(floor(min(corr_log2area_all, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  ceiling(max(corr_log2area_all, na.rm = TRUE)))

corrarea_mid <- ifelse(all(corrarea_lim == c(-1,1)), 0, 0.7)
if(all(corrarea_lim == c(-1,1))){
  corrarea_breaks <- seq(-1, 1, 0.2)
}else {
  corrarea_breaks <- seq(0, 1, 0.1)
}


if(all(is.na(corr_log2area_all))){
  warning("Correlation plot cannot be generated because there is no non-na correlation. Maybe the Areas were not included.")
}else{
  p_corr_log2area_all <-
  corr_log2area_all %>% 
  plot_corr() + 
  ggtitle("Log2Area correlation for all peptides")

ggplotly(p_corr_log2area_all)
}


```
